about_the_game:
Begin an epic journey through time with the Time Travelers Hamster Set! Time to dress up like doctor and his little helper, right? Watch as your hamsters becomes a time-traveling adventurers, ready to explore the past, present, and future.

This DLC contains a ready set of new costumes, as well as separate items for your hamster to dress up with other available elements.
